name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard addendum governing a provider's AI Services: use of input and output, usage restrictions, model training and non-training improvement, intellectual property and privacy, and disclaimers.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard DPA covering processor and subprocessor relationships, processing of personal data, restricted transfers, security incident response, audits, deletion of customer personal data, and limitation of liability.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for a cloud service subscription: service access, restrictions and obligations, privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard SLA for a cloud service: target uptime and its calculation, target response time, and remedies for missed targets.
